text: The Medical Officer of Health will provide an update on the Toronto Overdose Action Plan Implementation.

The Board of Health: 1. Directed the Toronto Public Health Drug Secretariat to convene a series of meetings with front-line harm reduction organizations, the Toronto Harm Reduction Alliance, health care providers like neighbourhood Community Health Centres, and the Toronto Community Housing Corporation to discuss the expansion of Supervised Injection Sites and Overdose Prevention Sites in Toronto. 2. Supported the implementation of Overdose Prevention Sites as part of the continuum of responses needed to address the current overdose emergency in Toronto. 3. Requested the Medical Officer of Health, in consultation with Emergency Medical Services staff, to discuss undertaking a data-sharing agreement to add suspected "party drug" overdoses. 4.
